description: Fuzzer implementation for testing the SpdySession component in Chromium, involving network socket mocking, SSL data provisioning, and request handling.

classes.name: FuzzerDelegate
classes.description: Implements net::SpdyStream::Delegate to handle stream events during fuzzing, primarily to trigger the done_closure upon closure.

classes.name: FuzzedSocketFactoryWithMockSSLData
classes.description: Extends FuzzedSocketFactory to add and create SSL client sockets with mock SSL data providers.

methods.name: FuzzerDelegate::OnClose
methods.description: Triggers the completion closure when the stream closes.

methods.name: FuzzedSocketFactoryWithMockSSLData::AddSSLSocketDataProvider
methods.description: Adds an SSL socket data provider to the mock SSL data array.

methods.name: FuzzedSocketFactoryWithMockSSLData::CreateSSLClientSocket
methods.description: Creates a mock SSL client socket using the next available mock SSL data provider.
